purpose: Refresh Smallcap Observatory holdings while the page is closed.
shortlist: Aditya Birla Sun Life Small Cap Fund
access: The Site uses password-only browser sign-in. Browser sessions can read holdings but cannot write them. Data reads by an updater, writes and this plan endpoint require X-Fund-Update-Key matching the UPDATE_KEY hosted secret, obtained through approved runtime secret injection. Sites service access alone does not authorize the application writer. Confirm ownership and publication through get_site; do not change the audience. Never log, persist or put credentials in a schedule prompt. If supported unattended secret access is unavailable, stop and report that prerequisite. No visitor session or connected app is needed when updater access is available.
sources: Read current snapshot.sources for exact public source URLs. Start with each fund house's official dated monthly portfolio spreadsheet or factsheet, then compare with at least one independent third-party portfolio page. If official extraction fails, require two third-party disclosures for the exact same month and retain provider_match status. Search for official disclosure pages as necessary. Websites may share feeds; do not equate matching copies with independent research.
verification: Check top FIFTEEN COMPANY securities and % of TOTAL net assets (% to NAV), excluding cash, TREPS and funds. Verify all fifteen names and weights against at least two distinct source domains using the exact portfolio date. Do not use NAV date as holdings date. Never estimate weights from prices. Never silently move backward in reporting month or mix monthly snapshots within a fund. Accept newer verified disclosures per fund and show per-fund dates.
write: GET current snapshot. Preserve immutable shortlist ids, names, monograms, colors and schedule. For each verified check set lastCheckedAt to actual check timestamp, checkStatus=checked or no_new; update holdings/date/sources/verification/notes only with supported evidence. On unresolved differences use checkStatus=conflict, retain last verified holdings, add a dated explanatory note and unmatched source. On inaccessible sources use failed and retain last verified holdings and lastCheckedAt. Set top-level checkedAt to actual run completion and concise truthful summary, including failures. POST application/json {snapshot: <complete Portfolio>, kind: 'check'}. Server records changes and history itself; supplied runs are ignored. Read GET /api/portfolio back and confirm saved checkedAt and changed figures. Saving data does not require republishing. Existing holdingsEvidence annotates expansion from full-portfolio records. Preserve it only while that same disclosure evidence still applies; replace or remove it when a newly cross-checked top-15 disclosure is imported. Never claim fifteen corroborated allocations when sources only verify five.
schema: version=1; checkedAt and updatedAt ISO timestamps; schedule={enabled:boolean,time:'08:00',timezone:'Asia/Kolkata'}; summary:string; funds exactly 24, each {id,name,monogram,color,verification:'official_match'|'official_only'|'provider_match'|'provider_only'|'conflict',checkStatus:'checked'|'no_new'|'failed'|'conflict',portfolioDate:'YYYY-MM-DD',lastCheckedAt:ISO,holdings:[{key:stable company identifier,name,weight:number}] exactly15 sorted descending,sources:[{label,url:https,type:'official'|'third_party',portfolioDate:'YYYY-MM-DD',matched:boolean}] at least2,notes:string[]}; runs preserved on input but managed by server.
failure: On read failure do not overwrite. On transient POST failure retry the same payload once and read back before any further retry. Report inability to update without claiming the check succeeded. Never weaken Site access or use preview/local storage.
monthlyArchive: Verified per-fund snapshots are archived by reporting month whenever the updater saves a check. Older monthly snapshots remain available. A requested month never falls back to another reporting month; missing funds are marked pending. The calendar month is in Asia/Kolkata. October 2026 is in progress on 2 October and is not a completed monthly portfolio. Do not supply future portfolio dates or relabel August holdings as September or October.

fullPortfolio.scope: Full equity company positions, including disclosed unlisted equity, excluding cash/TREPS/debt. Compare two adjacent months using shares held, never infer purchases from allocation weight.
fullPortfolio.verification: Extract ALL company rows from official dated monthly portfolios for both months, match by ISIN and reconcile renames, splits, bonus issues and mergers before classifying changes. Cross-check with another source domain. Withhold disputed previous quantities and put the row in review; never interpret missing/inaccessible data as an exit. Preserve top-15 records separately. The basis must distinguish official_disclosures from provider_quantity_comparison.
fullPortfolio.payload: POST {comparison:{fundId,currentDate,previousDate,checkedAt,scope:full_equity,basis,rows:[{key,name,previousQuantity:number|null,currentQuantity:number,weight:number|null,previousWeight:number|null,note:string|null}],sources:[{label,url,scope}],notes:[string]}}. Both dates are adjacent completed month-end disclosures. Numbers are absolute share quantities, not lakh/crore-scaled values. At least two source domains are required. GET back and verify.

selection: Retain the twenty fund IDs in lib/fund-catalog.ts; do not substitute bank-branded schemes, Tata, Franklin, Quant, ETFs, index funds or FoFs. Order uses scheme AUM, not a research-quality recommendation.
scopeNote: Twenty small-cap schemes plus four requested Helios equity schemes (Financial Services, Flexi Cap, Large & Mid Cap, Mid Cap). Keep their categories distinct. The five Helios schemes appear consecutively in alphabetical display order.
